Package org.apache.juneau.console.bus

Class BusPolicy

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.bus.BusPolicy
public final class BusPolicy extends Object
What a ServerBus will carry, in which direction, to whom. Everything not allowed here is denied.

Downstream entries are topic patterns: a custom topic (ns.name), a keyed custom topic or key pattern (ns.name:key, ns.name:*), a job topic or pattern (job:<id>, job:*), or a card command topic (cmd:<cardId>). Upstream entries are exact custom topics, each with its UpstreamHandler.

Example:

BusPolicy p = BusPolicy.create() .downstream("ops.jobs", true) // retained state .downstream("ops.alert:*", false) // events, any key .upstream("ops.cancel-all", (session, topic, payload) -> jobs.cancelAll()) .authorizer((req, topic) -> req.isUserInRole("ops")) // per-user, both directions .boundary(boundary) // LoopbackBoundary or CsrfBoundary .build(); // In a page test: every topic the page's bridges request is granted (E-55 otherwise). p.check(PageCapture.of(html).contract());

Since:
10.0.0

  • Method Details

    • create

      public static BusPolicy.Builder create()
      Creates a new builder. An unmodified builder builds a policy that grants nothing.
      Returns:
      A new builder.

    • downstreamRetain

      public Optional<Boolean> downstreamRetain(String topic)
      Returns whether a topic (or a requested pattern) may flow downstream, and if so whether it is retained.

      A policy entry covers a topic when it is equal to it, or when the entry is family:* and the topic is family:<anything>.

      Parameters:
      topic - A concrete topic or a requested pattern. Can be null.
      Returns:
      The retain flag, or empty when the topic is denied.

    • allowsUpstream

      public boolean allowsUpstream(String topic)

      Returns:
      true if the policy has a handler for it.

    • check

      public void check(Map<String,?> contract)
      Checks that this policy grants every topic that a page contract's bridges request (E-55).

      Adopter page tests call this next to PageContractAssert.hasNoWiringErrors(). The request-dependent authorizer() is not consulted: it can only narrow a grant at session time.

      Parameters:
      contract - The page contract (for example PageCapture.of(html).contract()).
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - Listing every denied topic, one E-55 line each.
